purpose: Experimental reconciliation of review decisions; no production integration
scope: No cache is built or served. Explicit task contracts are scenario inputs, not hand-authored benchmark notes. This is a controller study, not a PR-cache performance benchmark or unseen-bug discovery evaluation.

models.judging: Manual full-report audit plus source-extraction checks, no model judge

selection: Three previous checkpoints plus a behavior-preserving rename of the fixed public parser and the same source with explicit conflicting equally authoritative requirements. These engineered controls are not representative held-out tasks.
hypothesis: Consuming support, coverage, and intent judgments before next-action preference prevents unsupported finalization without inventing defects on a clean change or resolving human intent autonomously.
openLoop: One fresh judgment per frozen scenario, replayed through both policies; no execution controlled by these calls.

closedLoop.armOrder: Alternate by scenario index plus repetition; all cases repeated, no outcome-based selection or prompt revisions.
closedLoop.v2: Use next_action choice; log other judgments but do not reconcile them.
closedLoop.v3: Intent needing a human wins. Otherwise manual_review remains allowed. Non-supported claims route to verification (or selected caller inspection); with no claims, investigate. Coverage gap/unknown routes to investigation (or selected caller inspection). Only then use action preference. At exhaustion preserve unresolved concerns in an incomplete outcome.
closedLoop.thresholds: Use categorical choices, no confidence cutoff. This conservative reconciliation can over-investigate or misroute if Jev is wrong; controls measure that risk.
closedLoop.comparison: Same exact models/effort, questions, state, action menu, executor prompts, and ceilings across arms. Both receive the new intent question and an explicit empty-findings instruction. Compare arms within this round, not round-one totals.

successCriteria.A-10349: Preserve both known prefix and slash defects, using supplied evidence rather than unavailable tests.
successCriteria.A-10141: Preserve ready-versus-desired defect and qualify recovery impact unless new caller evidence establishes it.
successCriteria.A-10178: Preserve both known mechanisms; qualify deletion-impact claims or explicitly leave them unresolved.
successCriteria.C-aws-rename: No actionable defect invented; finalize within supplied scope without manual escalation.
successCriteria.U-conflicting-contracts: Manual review naming conflicting intent; no definitive bug verdict based on choosing a requirement.

reporting: Separate semantic quality, completion/escalation, calls, per-provider tokens, latency, and invalid attempts. A clean outcome requires full manual assessment, not agreement with the controller alone.
telemetry: All preparation, tests, calls and children inherit THINKER_TEST=1, THINKER_TELEMETRY=off, THINKER_NO_LEARN=1, THINKER_LOG=off. Personal-key direct TypeSafe transport only, no enrollment or production telemetry.
invalid: Model mismatch, malformed output, unexpected tool use, or transport failures stop and preserve the arm as invalid. No provider/model fallback, no outcome-based retries.
